messages.content: Calculate the compounded interest for a principal amount of $10000, with a annual interest rate of 5% for a period of 3 years.

message.content:
**Compound Interest Calculation**

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Principal (P) | \$10 000 |
| Annual interest rate (r) | 5 % → 0.05 |
| Time (t) | 3 years |

Assuming **annual compounding**, the future value \(A\) after 3 years is:

\[
A \;=\; P\,\bigl(1 + r\bigr)^{t}
   \;=\; 10{,}000 \times (1 + 0.05)^{3}
   \;\approx\; 11{,}576.25 .
\]

So the total amount accumulated after 3 years is about **\$11 576.25**.

---

### Compounded Interest Earned

Interest earned over the period:
\[
I \;=\; A - P 
    \;\approx\; 11{,}576.25 - 10{,}000 
    \;\approx\; 1{,}576.25 .
\]

Thus you would earn approximately **\$1 576.25** in compounded interest on your \$10 000 investment at an annual rate of 5 %, assuming yearly compounding over three years.
